components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call-to-action button; gold fill, navy text, resting glow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #d4af37; color: #060e1a; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 12px 24px; font-family: 'Sora', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: 0.01em; box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(212,175,55,0.35); transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), background-color 160ms ease, box-shadow 160ms ease; } @media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine) { .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #e8c766; box-shadow: 0 0 32px rgba(212,175,55,0.55); transform: scale(1.03); } } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f0d78c; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Outline button for a lower-emphasis second action alongside a primary CTA.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.3); border-radius: 9999px; padding: 12px 24px; font-family: 'Sora', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), border-color 160ms ease, box-shadow 160ms ease; } @media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine) { .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: rgba(212,175,55,0.5); box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(212,175,55,0.18); transform: scale(1.03); } } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Module Card
components.description: The recurring content card — used for Academia modules, feature blurbs, and content grids.
components.html:
✈

Meteorología

Interpretación de condiciones meteorológicas aplicadas a la operación de vuelo.
components.css: .ds-card { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border-radius: 16px; padding: 24px; transition: transform 250ms ease-out, border-color 250ms ease, background-color 250ms ease; } @media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine) { .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); border-color: rgba(212,175,55,0.4); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); } } .ds-card-icon { width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 12px; background: rgba(212,175,55,0.1); color: #e8c766; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 20px; margin-bottom: 20px; } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Sora', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 18px; color: #ffffff; margin: 0 0 8px; } .ds-card-body { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6); margin: 0; }

components.name: Gold Badge
components.description: Small status pill — gold for default/pending, also exists in green/red/neutral tones.
components.css: .ds-badge-gold { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid rgba(212,175,55,0.3); background: rgba(212,175,55,0.15); color: #e8c766; padding: 4px 12px; font-family: 'Sora', sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.02em; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Standard text input used across forms (agenda, project submission).
components.css: .ds-input { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15); border-radius: 12px; padding: 10px 16px; color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; transition: border-color 200ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.3); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: rgba(212,175,55,0.5); }

components.name: Active Nav Link
components.description: Pill-shaped nav link with the active-state glow and pulsing indicator dot.
components.css: .ds-navlink { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; white-space: nowrap; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid transparent; padding: 10px 16px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-weight: 300; font-size: 14px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7); transition: all 200ms ease; } @media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine) { .ds-navlink:hover { border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); color: #ffffff; } } .ds-navlink--active { border-color: rgba(212,175,55,0.4); background: rgba(212,175,55,0.1); color: #e8c766; box-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(212,175,55,0.25); } .ds-navlink-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #e8c766; }

components.name: Progress Bar
components.description: Gold-gradient progress indicator used throughout Academia for module/checklist/quiz progress.
components.css: .ds-progress { width: 100%; height: 10px; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); overflow: hidden; } .ds-progress-fill { height: 100%; border-radius: 9999px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #b3922c, #d4af37, #e8c766); transition: width 700ms ease-out; }

narrative.overview:
Villanueva Aviation reads like the debrief room before a training flight: serious, procedural, and unhurried. The room is dark navy — the color of a cabin at night — and gold appears the way rank insignia and instrument backlighting do: sparingly, and only where it means something (a call to action, an active state, a value worth noticing). Nothing in this system performs for attention; it earns trust by staying composed. This is explicitly not a casual community space — the product exists to feel like a training cockpit, never like a forum or a chat app.

Surfaces stay flat until a cadet interacts with them. Depth is never faked with drop shadows; instead, a warm gold glow signals "this is active" or "this is where you act next." Typography does the same job with restraint: a bold, geometric display face (Sora) for structure and command, and a quieter body face (Inter) for the actual reading. Text itself carries hierarchy through opacity, not new colors — a deliberate ladder of whites fading from confident to quiet.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-navy cabin as the constant ground; gold as an insignia, not a wash
Flat by default; glow (not shadow) is the only depth signal, and only on interaction
Generous rounding on anything clickable — pills for actions, soft corners for containers
A single opacity ladder of white carries the entire text hierarchy
Serious and procedural in tone — a cockpit, never a forum

rules.name: The Insignia Rule
rules.body: Gold covers no more than ~10% of any given screen — its rarity is what makes it read as significant.

rules.name: The One Ladder Rule
rules.body: Every text hierarchy decision is an opacity choice on white, never a new hue.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Only one typeface carries structure (Sora) and only one carries reading (Inter). A third face has never been introduced and shouldn't be.

rules.name: The Glow-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Depth is never implied with a dark drop shadow. When something needs to feel raised or active, it gets warmer (a gold glow), not darker.

dos: Do keep gold under ~10% of any screen — it reads as significant because it's rare (The Insignia Rule).
Do use the white-opacity ladder (white → /40) for every text-hierarchy decision instead of introducing a new color.
Do use full rounding on anything clickable-as-an-action, and reserve 16px/12px rounding for containers and nested fields respectively.
Do signal "active" or "raised" with a warmer gold glow, never a darker drop shadow.
Do gate hover-only effects behind @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) so touch devices don't get a "stuck" hover state.
donts: Don't add traditional drop shadows for depth or elevation — this system has none at rest.
Don't let gold dominate a screen or use it decoratively outside CTAs, active states, and labels.
Don't introduce a third typeface, or mix Sora and Inter within the same text element.
Don't let the product feel like a casual community space (Discord, a forum) — the tone is a training cockpit: composed, procedural, serious.
Don't use transition-all on interactive elements; name the exact properties that change.
